name: Ko-H5 Benchmark
description: Ko-H5 Benchmark is a comprehensive evaluation suite for Large Language Models in Korean, integrated into the Open Ko-LLM Leaderboard. It includes private test sets and supports robust evaluation with data leakage analysis and temporal performance tracking.
reputation: Well integrated in the Korean LLM community and mirrors the English Open LLM Leaderboard.
notes: Includes private test sets to prevent data leakage; supports linguistic diversity in LLM evaluation.
